title: Zhang and Zhang's unimodality conjecture for Clar covering polynomials
statement:
Let $H$ be a hexagonal system, meaning a 2-connected finite plane graph whose interior faces are regular hexagons of side length one. Let $R(H)$ be the resonance graph of $H$, and let $C(R(H),x)$ be its cube polynomial; equivalently, let $\zeta(H,x)$ denote the Clar covering polynomial of $H$.

**Zhang and Zhang's conjecture.** The polynomial

$$
C(R(H),x)=\zeta(H,x)
$$

is unimodal.

This conjecture concerns resonance graphs of hexagonal systems, a subclass of median graphs. The corresponding conjecture for all median graphs is false, but this restricted conjecture remains open.
references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2015–2023). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2004.12822](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.12822), [arXiv:1508.05024](https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.05024).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.14671

Status: **open** according to the source (as of March 2023). “Although Conjecture associated with median graphs is false, the conjecture on the resonance graphs of hexagonal systems (a subclass of median graphs) is still open.”
source_name: Yan-Ting Xie, Yong-De Feng and Shou-Jun Xu, “A relation between the cube polynomials of partial cubes and the clique polynomials of their crossing graphs”, arXiv:2303.14671 (2024).
